parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const asking=Number(d.asking_price??NaN),mao=Number(d.adjusted_mao??d.dynamic_mao??NaN),profit=Number(d.projected_assignment_profit??d.projected_profit??NaN),motivation=String(d.motivation??"unknown").toLowerCase(),dealType=String(d.deal_type??"residential").toLowerCase(),blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let decision="needs_evidence",state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Offer strategy inputs are incomplete or blocked.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id||!Number.isFinite(mao)){reason="Missing deal identity or dynamic MAO.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved deal blockers prevent acquisition decision.";}else if(!Number.isFinite(asking)){decision="needs_evidence";state="needs_evidence";route="WF-231";reason="Asking price is required before an acquisition decision.";}else if(asking<=mao&&(!Number.isFinite(profit)||profit>0)){decision="pursue";state="strategy_ready";route="WF-234";reason="Asking price is at or below dynamic MAO with viable economics.";}else if(asking>mao&&Number.isFinite(profit)&&profit>0){decision="negotiate";state="strategy_ready";route="WF-234";reason="Economics remain viable but asking price exceeds dynamic MAO.";}else{decision="pass";state="strategy_ready";route="WF-235";reason="Current pricing/economics do not support acquisition.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-233",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,deal_type:dealType,asking_price:asking,dynamic_mao:mao,projected_assignment_profit:Number.isFinite(profit)?profit:null,motivation,decision,state,route,reason,offer_strategy:{target_offer:decision==="pursue"?Math.min(asking,mao):decision==="negotiate"?Math.min(asking,mao):null,maximum_offer:mao,negotiation_required:decision==="negotiate"},requires_human_review:true}}];
